parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set security zones security-zone trust i.command: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone trust i.explanation: 将接口分配到安全区域。

set security zones security-zone untrust.command: set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1.0
set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: 将接口分配到安全区域。

set security nat source pool address-gro.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set security nat source pool address-gro.command: set security nat source pool address-group1 address 11.11.11.101 to 11.11.11.105

set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUTBOUND from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集的应用区域。

set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUTBOUND to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集的目标区域。

set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUTBOUND rule NAT-POLICY match source-address 192.168.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.explanation: 配置源NAT规则的匹配条件。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 源IP地址范围的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.command: set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUTBOUND rule NAT-POLICY then source-nat pool address-group1
set security nat source rule-set NAT-OUT.explanation: 配置源NAT规则的转换动作。
